module: 'Parking Spots' sub-editor of the sites editor. The module returns a class constructor C. A spot is an oriented box (pos, rot, scl); the editor provides a transform gizmo (transformUtil), size presets (Car 2.5x6x3, LargeCar 3.25x8x4, Bus 4x14x8), angle input in degrees, and the 'MultiSpot' mode that repeats the spot N times (1 to 25) in a direction (Left, Right, Front, Back) with an offset and a rotation. Creation, deletion, duplication (Shift + drag) and transforms go through editor.history (undoable).
notes: The entered angles are in degrees; internal rotations are quaternions (XYZ euler conversion in radians).
setSites restores rot from rotOrig if present (fixes rotations automatically adjusted for multispots) then removes rotOrig.
A duplicated spot gets a unique name 'Name (n)' via makeUniqueName.
hitTest returns nothing (nil) while the mouse is not pressed (mouseInfo.down); it tests the oriented box of each spot of the multispot with intersectsRay_OBB (the camera must be outside the box).

C.desc: Object returned by the constructor. Fields: sitesEditor, key, current (selected spot), list, isMultiSpot, multiSpotData (spotAmount, spotOffset, spotDirection, spotRotation), listDisplay (assigned by sitesEditor), requestGizmo.

init.desc: Constructor: prepares the multispot values, the drag state and the transformUtil utility ('Edit Sites', 'Transform'). Also defines the method C:requestGizmo(mode) which schedules the gizmo (re)configuration over 3 frames.

setSites.desc: Sets the edited sites, restores the original rotations of the multispots and deselects.

select.desc: Selects a spot: places the transform, enables editing and copies its multispot settings into the UI.

hitTest.desc: Returns the spot whose box (or one of the multispot boxes) is hit closest by the mouse ray, only on click.

create.desc: Creates a spot at the given position with the 'Car' scale (undoable action 'Create Parking Spot') and returns it.

remove.desc: Removes a spot (undoable action 'Remove Parking Spot').

setTransform.desc: Copies pos, rot, scl of the current spot into transformUtil.

updateFromTransform.desc: Copies pos, rot, scl from transformUtil to the current spot (during a drag).

updateTransform.desc: Records an undoable action 'Update Transform of ...' with the old and new values.

updateMultiSpot.desc: Copies the multispot settings from the UI to the current spot.

_beginShiftDuplicate.desc: Duplicates the current spot (undoable action 'Duplicate Parking Spot') when a drag starts with Shift, and makes the list adopt the copy.

drawElement.desc: Draws the spot editor: gizmo, size choice, rotation angles, 'Is MultiSpot' checkbox and its sliders (Amount of Spots 1 to 25, Offset 0 to 5, Spot Rotation -1.55 to 1.55).
